text:
alex_sales: URGENT — Aurora Payments pilot is hitting 429s on the submit_payment path right before today's demo (in ~40m). Customer sees browser error: "429 Too Many Requests". Tried simple retries, still failing. sample request-id: req_aurora_7f3

kevin_engineer: Are they on Hosted or Dedicated? Any rate-limit headers in the response?

alex_sales: Hosted trial. Response headers I grabbed: Retry-After: 2, X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0, X-RateLimit-Limit: 120/min. They were spamming parallel requests from the UI during load test.

maria_se: Ok — we can do a quick triage. Two tracks: (1) short-term: bump tenant burst for 15m so demo can complete; (2) post-demo: look at concurrency + client retry/backoff and recommend Dedicated or reserved QPS. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:

oncall_eng: On it. Need tenant id + the failing request-id. Also share a curl reproducer if you have one. I can tail the ingress logs: run `rg 'req_aurora_7f3' /var/log/redwood/*.log` or send me the request body.

alex_sales: Tenant: aurora-01. Reproducer (sanitized): `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/submit_payment -H 'Authorization: Bearer x...' -d '{"amount": 12.34, "currency":"USD", "card":"tok_test"}'` — they're hitting this from the UI with ~50 concurrent clients. Link to screenshot: https://drive.internal/aurora/demo_err.png

devops_bot: [autoscaler] cluster-gamma CPU at 78%, GPU pool free nodes: 0, recent deploy: stable@2026-11-18T15:12Z

kevin_engineer: Thanks. I can apply a temporary per-tenant burst override. Patch will be quick but needs an ops ack. Proposed change: `PATCH /admin/tenants/aurora-01 {"burst_capacity":500}` — will allow short spike while we investigate. Anyone object?

sara_re: If we do this, we should note in the account: demo success = high chance of upsell. Alex, please confirm customer impact so I can prepare concession language if needed.

maria_se: Also recommend reducing client parallelism to 8 and implementing exponential backoff (jitter). That will avoid hitting the token QPS limit. We can fallback to the lower-latency smaller model for the demo to reduce token/time per request.

oncall_eng: Ops acked via internal ticket #OPS-1193. Applying burst override for 20 minutes now. I'll watch logs and revert after the demo.

kevin_engineer: grabbing logs now — tail shows gateway returning 429 due to tenant bucket exhaustion:
```
[INGRESS] 2026-11-18T15:22:03Z tenant=aurora-01 req=req_aurora_7f3 route=/submit_payment status=429 reason=rate_limit_remaining=0
[INGRESS] 2026-11-18T15:22:03Z tenant=aurora-01 concurrent=48 token_window=60s limit=120/min
```

alex_sales: Demo resumed — customer completed the checkout flow. :raised_hands: Thank you team! Please leave the burst open for another 10m just in case.

oncall_eng: Leaving it open for 10 more minutes, then revert. Create a follow-up ticket to evaluate quota for aurora-01; likely recommend Dedicated or a reserved QPS commit.

sara_re: Noted — I'll prep pricing note and schedule a post-demo call. Also flagging security questionnaire about PCI flow — will open a separate thread so we don't mix docs in this war-room.

maria_se: Postmortem/action items: (1) client-side concurrency limits + backoff example snippet for Aurora, (2) quota recommendation + Dedicated trial offer, (3) run a short load test with suggested config, (4) doc for support playbook for customer-facing demos.

alex_sales: Perfect. Closing out here — will follow up with the pricing + SOC/PCI thread after the demo. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
